d: Yvette and Karl return to the very haunted Delapre Abbey, where Karl’s attempts to put Yvette in a room on her own, Yvette finds a lift and an unseen force makes itself known.
Croxteth Hall stands as one of the Most Haunted places in the UK and tonight Karl enters the deserted upper floors alone to see what lurks in the shadows.
The small cottage on the grounds of Eden Camp has a reputation of being incredibly haunted. This time Stuart enters alone to see what awaits him.
Karl walks the deserted buildings at the incredibly haunted Eden Camp to investigate the paranormal activity witnessed by countless unsuspecting people.
Gregg enters the formidable Dorchester Prison for the first time, filled with apprehension and fear, he soon asks himself if this is a good idea.
Part 2 sees Gregg venture ever deeper into the depths of Dorchester Prison and finds himself lost.
Karl enters the very haunted cottage at Eden Camp alone, and it doesn’t disappoint.
The buildings that once housed POW’s from WWII are now inhabited by many a ghostly apparition, Stuart enters the chapel in search of whatever haunts there.
HMP Shrewsbury is one of Britain’s Most Haunted prisons. Karl takes on C-Wing and the execution chamber in search of the spirits that lurk in the shadows of this formidable place.
Yvette and Mary investigate the abandoned top floor of the very haunted Croxteth Hall, and all hell breaks loose as something seems to be determined to stop the investigation.
Part 2 sees Karl investigated the first floor of this amazing location and it soon becomes clear that something is there with him.
Lost footage from Most Haunted’s shoot at Lancaster Grand Theatre resurfaces. In Part 1, a team member investigates the haunted dressing rooms alone—with eerie results.
Part two of the lost footage of the Lancaster Grand Theatre sees the team conducting a séance in the main auditorium where a ghostly figure makes an appearance.
In unseen footage from Clifton Hall, Most Haunted’s Gregg explores the attic alone after a chilling walk-through—hoping to uncover what hides in the shadows.
The team splits up in one of Britain’s most haunted prisons. In Part 1, Yvette, Mary, and Gregg enter the chilling A-Wing to investigate its many reported hauntings.
Part 2 of HMP Shrewsbury sees Karl, Glen, and Stuart explore C-Wing and the execution chamber, seeking answers to decades of terrifying paranormal reports.

Gregg enters the beautiful Townley Hall to look for some of the many spirits that are said to 
roam its dark corridors.
At Glemham Hall, Karl and Stuart explore for the first time. In Part 1, Karl investigates the deserted servants' quarters, where toys appear to move on their own.

In Part 2 of our investigation into Glemham Hall, Stuart walks the first floor rooms where 
something seems to be following him.
In Part 3 at Glemham Hall, Karl explores the first-floor bedrooms, where a mischievous spirit quickly makes its presence known.

While Karl walks the first floor, Stuart enters the old servant’s quarters and realises he is not 
alone for long.

As Karl enters, what seems to be the prison mortuary, he quickly finds out that something is 
trying to get his attention.
Stuart enters a previously unexplored area of the prison and it seems that he is not alone.
Filmed as a live show backup during COVID, this unseen vigil sees Karl, Gregg, and Stuart explore the eerie underbelly of a haunted location under strict safety guidelines.
Karl enters the haunted stable block and soon realises he is not alone.
Stuart walks the first floor of this old manor house to find what is said to haunt its corridors.
Glen explores Aberdeen’s haunted Tivoli Theatre, attempting to contact a stagehand ghost who died 80 years ago but has been seen there ever since.
After Guillermo Del Toro’s social media post about paranormal activity at his hotel, Gregg went to investigate the strange happenings firsthand.
Karl enters a cottage so haunted its owners keep its location secret. Inside, the atmosphere shifts to fear as a dark force reveals its power.
Karl enters Guys Cliffe House’s old stable block alone and soon senses the powerful spiritual energy said to haunt its dark corners.

Stuart investigates the two Masonic lodges at this very haunted location in search of the 
spirits of the long dead.
